acceptanceCriteria: Measure the 2 s racy-window guard on a coarse-timestamp filesystem (for example FAT/exFAT or an SMB/NFS mount) and record whether a same-second, same-size edit is ever served stale.
Linked worktrees and submodules get a stamp path, or a recorded measurement shows the Git fallback stays within the warm budget for them.
Windows gets a stamp path or a measured, documented fallback cost.
body: Residuals from PR beamfall/corvint#1559 (V1-2434, DCP-V1-314..317). The docs-corpus checkout freshness stamp is file metadata only (size, inode, timestamps). A same-second edit that keeps those is caught only by the 2 s racy-window guard, which is unmeasured on coarse-timestamp and network filesystems. Linked worktrees, submodules, alternates, config includes and non-Darwin/Linux platforms (Windows) always fall back to the slow Git path, so they do not get the warm-call speedup.
title: Docs-corpus freshness stamp: measure racy-window guard on coarse/network filesystems; cover linked worktrees, submodules and Windows
